text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Teio-san. Another year older, and you have 
grown even more dependable. —It brings me 
immense joy.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, McQueen. Hey, don't you think 
there's a fitting way to celebrate someone 
as magnificent as me?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So with that said, let me hear those 
birthday wishes again. Make 'em "firm, 
rich, and extra large"♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Firm, rich, extra portions"? For a honey 
drink? Very well. Let us start with firm—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Lady Teio. You are the one born to be the 
emperor of the world. On this day of your 
birth, I pledge my loyalty—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep, you have my favor. Keep going, 
keep going. Next, make it 'extra rich' 
with love components♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Daisuki"...!? I have never done anything 
like that before. I-I shall try to imitate 
you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Um... being able to celebrate by your side 
is... fun... no, more like blissful, I 
suppose... This is rather embarrassing, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep, and make sure to finish it off 
with 'extra' presents, okay? ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You're getting way too carried away! Mmh, 
if that's how it is...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, certainly. Just as you wish, I'll 
gift you a hefty dose of vitamin 
injections, jab after jab! —Chief 
physician!
